game.title: Terra Mystica
game.summary: 14の勢力から1つを担当し、地形を自勢力向けに変換して建物を広げ、6ラウンドを通じて建設・宗教・領域などから勝利点を競う。

nodes.normalized_statement: The game is played over six rounds. Every round consists of three phases in order: Income, Actions, then Cult bonuses and Clean-up.
nodes.section_heading: FLOW OF PLAY OVER SIX ROUNDS

nodes.normalized_statement: During the Income phase, players collect workers, coins, priests, and power according to visible income symbols from built structures, their bonus card, and favor tiles.

During the Action phase, a player who cannot or does not want to take further actions passes and takes no more actions that round. The first player to pass becomes the next round's starting player; when passing in rounds 1–5, return the current bonus card and take a different available one.

After all players have passed, award the Cult bonuses shown on the current scoring tile. In rounds 1–5, then perform clean-up for the next round, including refreshing action spaces and placing coins on leftover bonus cards.
nodes.section_heading: Phase III: Cult bonuses and clean-up phase

nodes.normalized_statement: At the end of the game, add end-game area scoring and Cult scoring to all victory points earned during play. The player with the most victory points wins.
